prompt: The Splice project {project} has two takes of the same TextEdit demo. The second attempt is the good one: keep only the second take on the timeline, and put a title reading "Take 2" over its first two seconds. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: only the second take
checks.expr: len(takes) == 2 and len(take_clips()) >= 1 and all(c['media'] == takes[1] for c in take_clips())

checks.name: title Take 2 at the start
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'title' and 'Take 2' in i['params'].get('text', '') for i in items)
